room.title: The King’s Road
room.epigraph: The board is small and the corners are far. Every road but one is a trap.
room.board:
Move 0 of 3. King on f6; 2 moves of open road.
Take back
Swear the road

Brandubh. Yours are the gold king and the pale defenders; the dark attackers answer each of your moves by a fixed published policy — they take if they can, otherwise they play whatever lengthens the king’s road. Every piece slides like a rook: any distance along a rank or file, through empty squares only. Only the king may stand on or pass through the four marked corners or the centre throne. A piece is taken when enemies close on it from both sides; walking between two enemies of your own accord is safe. Stand the king on any corner within 3 moves. Tap or Enter on a piece of yours to lift it — the squares it may take are marked.
